clue.text: Speciesist caper involving degenerate hard-core 12 model

indicators.note: the caper surrounds the rearranged group, so involving signals one piece holding another

parts.note: a caper is an antic, a playful prank

indicators.note: degenerate signals that the letters gathered here have decayed into a new order

parts.note: read as hard plus core: H is the pencil abbreviation for hard, then the word core as written
the answer to 12 across, top-shelf material
the Model T was Ford's famous car, so model gives T

explanation.surface: A diatribe against a speciesist stunt involving some degenerate pornographic model.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hard-core' splits as H (hard) plus CORE; 'degenerate' scrambles those with PORN and T, and 'involving' sets that scramble between the third and fourth letters of the caper.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone anthropocentric regards humans as central, which is the attitude a speciesist holds toward other animals.

clue.text: Mourner, inwardly, oddly redolent of dog

explanation.definitionFit: A golden retriever is a popular breed of gun dog with a yellow coat.

clue.text: Deceased bird in port, perhaps, on ship with no outlook

explanation.definitionFit: A room without windows has no outlook, no view of the outside.
